propositions: bare-repository fixture commands fail under safe.bareRepository=explicit when using implicit discovery (git -C or cwd) instead of explicit --git-dir targeting
git config gc.autoDetach false and git symbolic-ref HEAD operations in test fixtures and prepare_reclaim_backup.py return exit 128 when repository kind is not explicitly specified
commands that intentionally own bare test repositories must use top-level --git-dir to explicitly select the repository, while generic helpers serving worktrees retain -C behavior
worktree operations must not be regressed by bare-repository targeting fixes; helpers must distinguish between bare and worktree callers or use repository-kind-explicit forms
portable test execution requires supported tests to run locally and in CI under both default and explicit Git safety configurations without host/global mutation
